# goal

take clean occurrence data, model niches, then calculate niche overlap between pairs

## load packages
```{r}
library(raster)
library(dismo)
library(sf)
library(geodata)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rangeBuilder)
library(usdm)
library(terra)         # For raster data
library(ENMeval)       # For ENM evaluation and tuning
library(predicts)      # For niche modeling tools
library(rnaturalearth) # For downloading shapefiles of countries and states
library(ggspatial)     # Scale bars and north arrows
```

## pull CHELSA data

pulls the 19 CHELSA v2.1 bioclim layers (1981-2010, 30 arc-sec) with
[SpeciesDistributionToolkit.jl](https://github.com/PoisotLab/SpeciesDistributionToolkit.jl),
crops them to the extent of all the final occurrence points, and saves one tif per layer.

The global tifs are cached in `~/.julia/SimpleSDMDatasets/CHELSA2/BioClim` (~5 GB for all 19),
so this is only slow the first time. This is a julia chunk in an R doc, so run it by hand.

SpeciesDistributionToolkit needs HTTP 1.x & PlantOccurrences needs HTTP 2.x, so SDT lives in its
own environment (`scripts/niche_modeling_env`) instead of the main project.

```{julia eval = FALSE}
using Pkg
Pkg.activate("scripts/niche_modeling_env")
using CSV, DataFrames
using SpeciesDistributionToolkit

final_dir  = "data/occurrence_data/pt_occs_final"
chelsa_dir = "data/niche_modeling/bioclim/chelsa2.1_30s"
buffer     = 1.0 # degrees added on each side of the occurrence extent

# bounding box of every final occurrence point
lons, lats = Float64[], Float64[]
for f in filter(endswith(".csv"), readdir(final_dir; join = true))
    df = CSV.read(f, DataFrame; select = [:longitude, :latitude])
    append!(lons, skipmissing(df.longitude))
    append!(lats, skipmissing(df.latitude))
end
bbox = (left = minimum(lons) - buffer, right = maximum(lons) + buffer,
        bottom = minimum(lats) - buffer, top = maximum(lats) + buffer)

provider = RasterData(CHELSA2, BioClim)
mkpath(chelsa_dir)

for i in 1:19
    # zero-padded so that list.files() in R returns the layers in order
    out = joinpath(chelsa_dir, "chelsa2.1_30s_bio_$(lpad(i, 2, '0')).tif")
    isfile(out) && continue
    println("Pulling CHELSA BIO$i")
    layer = SDMLayer(provider; layer = "BIO$i", bbox...)
    SimpleSDMLayers.save(out, layer)
end
```


## process CHELSA data

following this tutorial: https://soltislab.github.io/BotanyENMWorkshops/climate-processing.html

load and stack climatic variables:
```{r}
biolist <- list.files("data/niche_modeling/bioclim/chelsa2.1_30s",
                      pattern = "\\.tif$",
                      full.names = TRUE)
biostack <- terra::rast(biolist)
names(biostack) <- gsub("chelsa2.1_30s_", "", names(biostack))
```

crop layers to extent of all Calceolaria:
```{r}
occ_files <- list.files("data/occurrence_data/pt_occs_final",
                        pattern = "\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
alldf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(occ_files, function(f) {
  read.csv(f)[, c("accepted_name", "longitude", "latitude")]
}))
alldf <- alldf[complete.cases(alldf), ]

# keep only taxa with at least 15 points
min_pts <- 15
alldf <- alldf %>%
         group_by(accepted_name) %>%
         filter(n() >= min_pts) %>%
         ungroup()

# Convert occurrence data to an sf object
alldfsp <- st_as_sf(alldf,
                    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                    crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
oudir  <- "data/niche_modeling/bioclim/chelsa_cropped"

# Loop through each unique species in the occurrence data
for (species in unique(alldf$accepted_name)) {

  # Print current species for progress tracking
  message("Processing species: ", species)

  # Subset occurrence data for this species
  species_df <- alldf %>%
                filter(accepted_name == species)

  # Convert species occurrences to sf
  species_sf <- st_as_sf(species_df,
                         coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                         crs = 4326)

  # Run alpha hull via rangeBuilder
  hull <- rangeBuilder::getDynamicAlphaHull(x = species_df,
                                            coordHeaders = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                                            fraction = 1,
                                            partCount = 1,
                                            initialAlpha = 20,
                                            clipToCoast = "terrestrial",
                                            verbose = FALSE)

  # Convert hull to sf
  hull_sf <- st_as_sf(hull[[1]])

  # Transform hull and points to equal-area projection
  proj <- "+proj=cea +lat_ts=0 +lon_0=0"
  hull_sf_proj <- st_transform(hull_sf, crs = proj)
  species_sf_proj <- st_transform(species_sf, crs = proj)

  # Calculate nearest-neighbor distances
  dist_matrix <- st_distance(species_sf_proj)
  nearest_neighbor_dists <- apply(dist_matrix, 2, function(x) sort(x)[2])
  buffer_distance <- quantile(nearest_neighbor_dists, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Buffer the hull
  buffer_proj <- st_buffer(hull_sf_proj, dist = buffer_distance)

  # Union polygons in case of multiple pieces
  buffer_proj <- st_union(buffer_proj)

  # Transform both hull and buffered hull back to WGS84 for plotting
  hull_sf_wgs84 <- st_transform(hull_sf_proj, crs = 4326)
  buffer_wgs84 <- st_transform(buffer_proj, crs = 4326)

  # plot hull before buffering
  p_before <- ggplot() +
              geom_sf(data = hull_sf_wgs84, fill = "gray70", alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
              geom_sf(data = species_sf, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
              theme_minimal() +
              ggtitle(paste("Alpha Hull (No Buffer) -", species))

  # plot after buffering alpha hull
  p_after <- ggplot() +
             geom_sf(data = buffer_wgs84, fill = "gray70", alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
             geom_sf(data = species_sf, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
             theme_minimal() +
             ggtitle(paste("Buffered Hull -", species))

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_before, p_after, ncol = 2)

  # Convert buffered area to terra SpatVector
  buffer_vect <- terra::vect(buffer_wgs84)

  # Define output directory for this species
  spec <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
  species_dir <- file.path(oudir, spec)
  dir.create(species_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Loop through each raster layer and crop/mask to buffered area
  for (i in seq_along(biolist)) {

    rast <- biostack[[i]]

    # Crop raster to extent
    rast_crop <- crop(rast, buffer_vect)

    # Mask raster to buffered hull shape
    rast_mask <- mask(rast_crop, buffer_vect)

    # Define output file name
    layer_name <- names(rast)
    outfile <- file.path(species_dir, paste0(layer_name, ".tif"))

    # Write cropped raster
    writeRaster(rast_mask,outfile,overwrite = TRUE)

    message("  Cropped and saved: ", outfile)
  }
}
```

vif selection:
```{r}
# Loop through each species
for (species in unique(alldf$accepted_name)) {
  spec <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
  spec_dir <- file.path(oudir, spec)

  # Read in species cropped rasters and stack them
  cropped_files <- list.files(spec_dir,
                              pattern = "\\.tif$",
                              full.names = TRUE)

  species_stack <- terra::rast(cropped_files)

  # Calculate VIF and exclude collinear variables
  vif_result <- usdm::vifstep(species_stack, th = 10)
  message("VIF calculated for species: ", species)

  reduced_stack <- usdm::exclude(species_stack, vif_result)

  # Create a folder for VIF-selected layers
  vif_dir <- file.path(spec_dir, "VIF")
  unlink(vif_dir, recursive = TRUE) # clear layers left over from previous runs
  dir.create(vif_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Save each retained raster layer
  for (layer_name in names(reduced_stack)) {

    r_layer <- reduced_stack[[layer_name]]

    out_file <- file.path(vif_dir, paste0(layer_name, ".tif"))

    terra::writeRaster(r_layer,
                       out_file,
                       overwrite = TRUE)

    message("Saved layer: ", out_file)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# List species folders in the cropped directory
species_dirs <- list.dirs(oudir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Loop through each species folder
for (species_dir in species_dirs) {

  # Extract species name from folder path
  species_name <- basename(species_dir)

  # List all cropped raster files for this species
  cropped_files <- list.files(species_dir,
                              pattern = "\\.tif$",
                              full.names = TRUE)

  # Stack the rasters for this species
  cropped_stack <- terra::rast(cropped_files)

  # Calculate correlation matrix
  corr <- terra::layerCor(cropped_stack, fun = "cor", na.rm = TRUE)

  # Extract absolute Pearson correlation values
  cor_abs <- abs(corr$correlation)

  # Define output CSV path
  corr_outfile <- file.path(species_dir, paste0("correlationBioclim_", species_name, ".csv"))

  # Write correlation matrix to CSV
  write.csv(cor_abs, corr_outfile,row.names = TRUE)

}
```

## running ENMs

### test on single species - alba

```{r}
#load in data for alba

Calceolaria_atahualpae <- read.csv("data/occurrence_data/pt_occs_final/Calceolaria_atahualpae.csv")
Calceolaria_alba <- read.csv("data/occurrence_data/pt_occs_final/Calceolaria_alba.csv")

vif_list <- list.files("data/niche_modeling/bioclim/chelsa_cropped/Calceolaria_atahualpae/VIF/",
                       full.names = TRUE,
                       recursive = FALSE)

# Load as raster stack
vifStack <- terra::rast(vif_list)
```

```{r}
# ENMeval model generation:
# - Tests combinations of feature classes (FC)
# - Tests different regularization multipliers (RM)

eval <- ENMevaluate(occs = Calceolaria_atahualpae[, c("longitude", "latitude")],
                    envs = vifStack,
                    tune.args = list(fc = c("L", "Q"), rm = 1:2),
                    partitions = "block",
                    n.bg = 10000,
                    parallel = FALSE,
                    algorithm = 'maxent.jar')

# Save ENMeval object
save(eval, file = "data/niche_modeling/outputs/Calceolaria_atahualpae_ENM_eval.RData")
```

```{r}
# Extract predictions from ENMeval object
maps <- eval@predictions

# Plot first 6 prediction rasters
terra::plot(maps,
            nc = 2,
            main = names(maps))
```

```{r}
# Calculate Schoener's D among all models
mod_overlap <- calc.niche.overlap(maps, overlapStat = "D")
print(mod_overlap)

# Retrieve summary table
results <- eval.results(eval)
head(results)

## Plot model tuning results
evalplot.stats(e = eval,
               stats = c("or.10p", "auc.val"),
               color = "fc",
               x.var = "rm")
```

```{r}
opt.seq <- results %>%
           filter(!is.na(AICc)) %>%                      # Exclude models with NA AICc
           filter(AICc == min(AICc)) %>%                 # Minimum AICc
           filter(or.10p.avg != 0) %>%                   # Exclude zero omission
           filter(or.10p.avg == min(or.10p.avg)) %>%     # Minimum omission
           filter(auc.val.avg == max(auc.val.avg))       # Maximum AUC

opt.seq

# Save optimal model summary
write.table(opt.seq,
            file = "data/niche_modeling/outputs/Calceolaria_alba_OptModel.txt",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
make_corr_matrix <- function(occurrences, environment_data){
  #trim environmental layers to the extent of the occurrence data
  #this trimmed version ONLY for the purpose of correlation analysis

  #getting the max and min lon and lat for the extent of the clipping mask
  collapsed_occ_list <- do.call(rbind, occurrences)
  max_lat <- max(collapsed_occ_list$latitude)
  min_lat <- min(collapsed_occ_list$latitude)
  max_lon <- max(collapsed_occ_list$longitude)
  min_lon <- min(collapsed_occ_list$longitude)
  rect_lats <- c(max_lat, max_lat, min_lat, min_lat)
  rect_lons <- c(max_lon, min_lon, min_lon, max_lon)
  rect_coords <- cbind(rect_lons, rect_lats)

  ##make spatial polygon##
  p <- sp::Polygon(rect_coords)
  ps <- sp::Polygons(list(p),1)
  polygon_mask <- sp::SpatialPolygons(list(ps))

  ##crop raster stack##
  cropped_clim_corr <- raster::crop(environment_data, polygon_mask)

  #correlation analysis between layers
  print("Calculating correlation coefficients of climatic variables")
  corr <- raster::layerStats(cropped_clim_corr, 'pearson', na.rm=TRUE)
  c_matrix <- corr$`pearson correlation coefficient`
  name <- paste0("correlationBioClim", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
  print(paste0("Saving correlation coefficients to file in your current working directory: ",
               getwd(), "/", name))
  write.csv(c_matrix, file = name)

  #make a correlation plot, highlighting  absolute values greater than 0.8
  df <- raster::as.data.frame(c_matrix)
  ggplot2::ggcorr(df, geom = "blank", label = TRUE, hjust = 0.75) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 10, aes(alpha = abs(coefficient) > 0.8)) +
    ggplot2::scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.25, "FALSE" = 0)) +
    ggplot2::guides(color = FALSE, alpha = FALSE)

  #export plot as a pdf, saved as correlation_plot.pdf in your working directory
  name <- paste0("correlationsBioClim", Sys.Date(), ".pdf")
  print(paste0("Saving PDF of correlation coefficients plot to your current working directory: ",
               getwd(), "/", name))
  print("Correlation coefficients greater than .8 or less than -.8 are highlighted in grey.")
  ggplot2::ggsave(name, plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", path = NULL,
         scale = 1, width = NA, height = NA)

  return(c)
}

make_corr_matrix()
```

#fixit

```{r}
#' model niches
#'
#' A function to create maxent species distribution models for large numbers of taxa.
#' @param occ_data A **named** list of dataframes; each element is a dataframe of
#'   occurrence data for one species (must have `longitude` and `latitude` columns).
#' @param enviro_data A RasterStack of environmental rasters.
#' @param reps The number of replicates. Default is 3.
#' @param reptype Maxent replicatetype: "bootstrap", "subsample", or "crossvalidate".
#'   Default is "bootstrap".
#' @param output_dir Directory for saving prediction rasters. Created if absent.
#'   Use "" to skip saving to disk.
#' @return A named list with two elements: `maxent_objs` and `predictions`.
model_niches <- function(occ_data, enviro_data, reps = 3, reptype = "bootstrap", output_dir = "") {

  # Create output directory if specified and doesn't exist
  if (nchar(output_dir) > 0 && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message("Created output directory: ", output_dir)
  }

  maxent_objs <- list()
  predictions <- list()

  for (i in seq_along(occ_data)) {

    sp_name <- sub(" ", "_", names(occ_data)[i])

    # only proceed if this isn't a duplicate entry
    if (sp_name %in% names(maxent_objs)) {
      message("Skipping duplicate: ", sp_name)
      predictions[[i]] <- NA
      names(predictions)[i]  <- NA
      next
    }

    message("Working on ", sp_name, " (species ", i, " of ", length(occ_data), ")")

    ##### Prepare occurrence data: select lon/lat columns, drop NAs, convert to matrix
    a  <- dplyr::select(occ_data[[i]], longitude, latitude)
    a  <- a[complete.cases(a), ]

    if (nrow(a) < 1) {
      warning(sp_name, ": no usable coordinates — skipping.")
      predictions[[i]] <- NA
      names(predictions)[i] <- sp_name
      maxent_objs[[i]] <- NA
      names(maxent_objs)[i] <- sp_name
      next
    }

    sp <- as.matrix(a)   # dismo::maxent needs a plain matrix

    #####  MAXENT modeling
    mx <- tryCatch(
      dismo::maxent(enviro_data, sp, removeDuplicates = TRUE,
                    replicates = reps, replicatetype = reptype),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(sp_name, ": maxent failed — ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(mx)) {
      predictions[[i]] <- NA
      names(predictions)[i] <- sp_name
      maxent_objs[[i]] <- NA
      names(maxent_objs)[i] <- sp_name
      next
    }

    maxent_objs[[i]] <- mx
    names(maxent_objs)[i] <- sp_name

    # check that at least some variables contribute to the model
    # (var.importance is not exported; extract directly from mx@results)
    total_perc_contribution <- tryCatch({
      contrib_idx <- grep("contribution", rownames(mx@results), ignore.case = TRUE)
      if (length(contrib_idx) > 0) sum(mx@results[contrib_idx, ], na.rm = TRUE) else 1
    }, error = function(e) 1)  # if extraction fails, default to non-zero and proceed

    if (total_perc_contribution != 0) {

      pred <- tryCatch({

        # set extent based on point locations plus a 5 % buffer
        e2 <- raster::extent(sp) * 1.05

        # Always predict in memory first — passing filename= directly to
        # dismo::predict triggers an 'invalid scipen' bug in newer raster
        # versions. Write to disk separately via raster::writeRaster instead.
        pred_raster <- dismo::predict(mx, enviro_data, ext = e2)

        if (nchar(output_dir) > 0) {
          raster::writeRaster(pred_raster,
                              filename  = paste0(output_dir, sp_name, ".asc"),
                              overwrite = TRUE)
          message("  Saved: ", paste0(output_dir, sp_name, ".asc"))
        }

        pred_raster

      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sp_name, ": prediction failed — ", conditionMessage(e))
        NA
      })

      predictions[[i]] <- pred
      names(predictions)[i] <- sp_name

    } else {
      warning(sp_name, ": all variable contributions are 0 — skipping prediction.")
      predictions[[i]] <- NA
      names(predictions)[i] <- sp_name
    }
  }

  return(list(maxent_objs = maxent_objs, predictions = predictions))
}
```

```{r}
# Load Calceolaria alba occurrence data (filtered / georef-merged)
alba_df <- read.csv(
  "data/occurrence_data/pt_occs_final/Calceolaria_alba.csv"
)

# Wrap in a named list as required by model_niches
occ_list <- list("Calceolaria alba" = alba_df)

# Run model — 3 bootstrap replicates, output saved to data/niche_modeling/outputs/
results_alba <- model_niches(
  occ_data    = occ_list,
  enviro_data = clim_data,
  reps        = 3,
  reptype     = "bootstrap",
  output_dir  = "data/niche_modeling/outputs/"
)

# Inspect results
print(results_alba$maxent_objs)
plot(results_alba$predictions[["Calceolaria_alba"]], main = "Calceolaria alba — MaxEnt prediction")
```
